testSuite: CV-20 Fault Injection & Recovery Qualification (FR-059..FR-074, NFR-001..NFR-024)

scenarios.name: Sudden Worker Process Loss (SIGKILL)
scenarios.failureInjected: Worker process abruptly terminated mid-flight during brief analysis
scenarios.mitigationMechanism: Durable state checkpointing via PostgreSQL transactions & atomic .tmp file swap
scenarios.observedBehavior: On restart, unacknowledged jobs cleanly re-queued from outbox; acknowledged jobs intact

scenarios.name: Disk Write Failure (Read-Only / ENOSPC)
scenarios.failureInjected: State directory mounted read-only during asset persistence
scenarios.mitigationMechanism: Atomic rename isolation; honest health marks disk as read_only; 503 reported
scenarios.observedBehavior: No partial corrupt files written; health probe immediately reflects disk: read_only

scenarios.name: Canva Cloud Provider Outage (503 / Timeout)
scenarios.failureInjected: Simulated Canva API failure (3 consecutive HTTP 503 timeouts)
scenarios.mitigationMechanism: CircuitBreaker trips to OPEN; requests fail-fast; cooldown backoff triggered
scenarios.observedBehavior: Dependent Canva edits paused; honest health marks canva: outage; chat intake and stored captures remain 100% operational

scenarios.name: Canva Cloud Provider Recovery
scenarios.failureInjected: Simulated restoration of Canva API after outage
scenarios.mitigationMechanism: CircuitBreaker half-open probe succeeds and transitions back to CLOSED
scenarios.observedBehavior: Honest health immediately restores to healthy; queued operations resume safely

scenarios.name: Expired OAuth Credentials / Token Revocation
scenarios.failureInjected: Canva API returns 401 Unauthorized / Token Expired
scenarios.mitigationMechanism: Structured AppError CANVA_AUTH_EXPIRED; task placed into BLOCKED_NEEDS_OPERATOR
scenarios.observedBehavior: No infinite crash loop; task history preserved; operator alerted with re-auth link

scenarios.name: Design Permission Revocation (HTTP 403)
scenarios.failureInjected: Canva design access revoked by external client workspace admin
scenarios.mitigationMechanism: Structured AppError DESIGN_ACCESS_REVOKED; task locked to prevent dropped edits
scenarios.observedBehavior: Action halted with clear actionable error; operator guided to request Canva team seat

scenarios.name: Unavailable Browser Automation Session
scenarios.failureInjected: Canva web automation browser session crashes or disconnects
scenarios.mitigationMechanism: Headless automation lease times out; falls back to manual edit handoff URL
scenarios.observedBehavior: Operator provided direct Canva edit URL (FR-078); task state remains consistent

scenarios.name: Google Workspace Delivery Drift
scenarios.failureInjected: Drive asset missing or Sheet status diverges from PostgreSQL authoritative record
scenarios.mitigationMechanism: ReconciliationService audits discrepancies and auto-repairs missing assets
scenarios.observedBehavior: Drift detected and repaired; Drive file re-uploaded idempotently; Sheet row synced

scenarios.name: Channel Ingress Attack / Flooding (Kill Switch)
scenarios.failureInjected: Simulated high-volume spam or rogue bot on Telegram/WAHA channel
scenarios.mitigationMechanism: Selective channel kill switch toggled via /operations/kill-switch
scenarios.observedBehavior: Target channel blocked instantly; health reflects degraded (kill_switch_active); core processing unaffected
